note: Item codes Self-efficacy1..4 are the deposit's own column names (peerj-07-7402-s001.xlsx, sheet 'Raw data', no text labels at either level); wording from Scales S1 (peerj-07-7402-s002.pdf), whose Italian and English versions number the four items 1-4 and print the 1-4 resp header over the four statements of each item, low to high efficacy (paper: 1 'low efficacy' ... 4 'high efficacy'). Administered in Italian (Italian schoolchildren); base fields hold S1's Italian version, _translated fields hold S1's English version (authors' own). (2008) 6-item physical self-efficacy scale (4 statements selected, pictograms added); published CC BY 4.0 in PeerJ; no restriction on the wording was found in the paper or supplement (Colella's own terms not separately checked).
